name: Sarah Elfreth
stance: Ties the FAA case to the broader need to regulate AI safety before it is deployed in critical systems.

statements.text: Congress cannot afford to miss the moment on AI regulation. While reasonable people may disagree on how precisely to regulate this technology, we are beyond denying that action is required.
Joined Rep. Sam Liccardo in urging Speaker Johnson to reconvene the House and advance bipartisan AI safeguards.
Joined Rep. Yassamin Ansari and over 40 House Democrats in urging the administration to establish a coordinated global framework with allies to regulate AI development.
Co-led the letter urging the FAA to pause its AI-enabled air-traffic tool pending safety testing and oversight answers.
As AI safety concerns are top of mind for our neighbors, this is another instance where we cannot afford to miss the moment on regulating this technology.
Joined Rep. Brad Sherman and colleagues in urging increased funding for the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI), which evaluates AI systems.
We cannot afford to miss the mark on AI safety and oversight.
Urged the Speaker to bring Congress back and regulate AI, citing reports of rogue AI agents at Anthropic.
